reading_note: The arc traces how the four discrete degrees of divine good (the "elements") descend from the Lord, are mingled with falsity-from-evil in the first temptation, and are received into the regenerating natural where the body becomes their vessel. As each evil is unmasked, a deeper evil is exposed: bond→wrath→desire→bitterness→heat→flesh→gloom→severity→winds of shame, twelve successive strippings — a complete circuit of self-love laid bare. The same four goods, when received in someone receptive, are gathered inward through spiritual nourishment, conjoin with the New Man (the regenerate form), receive the Mind of Light (illustration), are purified, and rise to their first rest. Those who receive them in sinners only multiply evil, and their end is judgment and transference into their own state.
